summary: Strengthen audit planning, control testing, Excel analysis, and reporting in this five-day course. Review the curriculum and enquire about delivery.
lede: Auditing and analytical techniques help internal auditors and assurance professionals plan reviews and test controls using reliable evidence. Participants practice assessing risk, defining audit scope, selecting samples, evaluating evidence, and analyzing exceptions with Excel. They also develop control tests, evidence-linked findings, and follow-up reports, while AI-assisted anomaly review and the Three Lines Model receive introductory, discussion-based coverage.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, perform, supervise, or use internal audit and assurance work. It suits intermediate practitioners who want to strengthen evidence testing, analytical review, and audit reporting.
modules: Global Internal Audit Standards and Risk
prerequisites: Working familiarity with internal controls, business processes, or audit documentation is expected. Basic Excel skills, including sorting and using formulas, will support the hands-on data exercises. No programming experience is required.
